name: Beta:Over
source:
She is your online friend, who is currently developing her first video game called "Ghastly Crimes". Normally a talkative and passionate person, the Zoe calling you tonight is strangely quiet. What's going on with her and will you be able to cheer her up?

[From [url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/betaover]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她是你的在线朋友，目前正在开发她的第一个视频游戏，名为“Ghastly Crimes”。佐伊平时是个健谈、热情的人，但今晚给你打电话的佐伊却出奇地安静。她发生了什么事，你能让她高兴起来吗？

[来自[url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/betaover]itch.io[/url]]
